API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIIntermediate CA CertificatesIntermediate Cert Resource Add Intermediate Ca Certificate
Intermediate Cert Resource Add Intermediate Ca Certificate
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/intermediateCaCertificate

Adds a custom intermediate CA certificate that can be used for SSL inspection. Custom intermediate certificates can be added with software protection or cloud HSM based on your subscriptions. In cloud HSM protection, your certificate private keys are stored in a cloud hardware security module (HSM) located in a region of your choice.

With cloud HSM protection subscription, you can add up to eight custom intermediate certificates using either cloud HSM or software protection and only four certificates can be active at a time. With software protection subscription, you can add up to 2 intermediate certificates and only one certificate can be active at a time.

To learn more, see Configuring Cloud HSM Protection Intermediate CA Certificate and Configuring Software Protection Intermediate CA Certificate.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Intermediate CA certificate information.

name
string
REQUIRED

Name of the intermediate CA certificate

type
string
REQUIRED

Type of the intermediate CA certificate. Available types: Zscaler’s intermediate CA certificate (provided by Zscaler), custom intermediate certificate with software protection, and custom intermediate certificate with cloud HSM protection.

Possible values: [ZSCALER, CUSTOM_SW, CUSTOM_HSM]

region
string

Location of the HSM resources. Required for custom intermediate CA certificates with cloud HSM protection.

Possible values: [GLOBAL, ASIA, EUROPE, US]

status
string

Determines whether the intermediate CA certificate is enabled or disabled for SSL inspection. Subscription to cloud HSM protection allows a maximum of four active certificates for SSL inspection at a time, whereas software protection subscription allows only one active certificate.

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED]

defaultCertificate
boolean

If set to true, the intermediate CA certificate is the default intermediate certificate. Only one certificate can be marked as the default intermediate certificate at a time.

description
string

Description for the intermediate CA certificate

currentState
string

Tracks the progress of the intermediate CA certificate in the configuration workflow

Possible values: [GENERAL_DONE, KEYGEN_DONE, PUBKEY_DONE, ATTESTATION_DONE, ATTESTATION_VERIFY_DONE, CSRGEN_DONE, INTCERT_UPLOAD_DONE, CERTCHAIN_UPLOAD_DONE, CERT_READY]

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Unique identifier for the intermediate CA certificate

name
string
REQUIRED

Name of the intermediate CA certificate

type
string
REQUIRED

Type of the intermediate CA certificate. Available types: Zscaler’s intermediate CA certificate (provided by Zscaler), custom intermediate certificate with software protection, and custom intermediate certificate with cloud HSM protection.

Possible values: [ZSCALER, CUSTOM_SW, CUSTOM_HSM]

region
string

Location of the HSM resources. Required for custom intermediate CA certificates with cloud HSM protection.

Possible values: [GLOBAL, ASIA, EUROPE, US]

status
string

Determines whether the intermediate CA certificate is enabled or disabled for SSL inspection. Subscription to cloud HSM protection allows a maximum of four active certificates for SSL inspection at a time, whereas software protection subscription allows only one active certificate.

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED]

defaultCertificate
boolean

If set to true, the intermediate CA certificate is the default intermediate certificate. Only one certificate can be marked as the default intermediate certificate at a time.

certStartDate
int64

Start date of the intermediate CA certificate’s validity period

certExpDate
int64

Expiration date of the intermediate CA certificate’s validity period

description
string

Description for the intermediate CA certificate

currentState
string

Tracks the progress of the intermediate CA certificate in the configuration workflow

Possible values: [GENERAL_DONE, KEYGEN_DONE, PUBKEY_DONE, ATTESTATION_DONE, ATTESTATION_VERIFY_DONE, CSRGEN_DONE, INTCERT_UPLOAD_DONE, CERTCHAIN_UPLOAD_DONE, CERT_READY]

publicKey
string

Public key in the HSM key pair generated for the intermediate CA certificate

keyGenerationTime
int32

Timestamp when the HSM key was generated

hsmAttestationVerifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the attestation for the HSM key was verified

csrFileName
string

Certificate Signing Request (CSR) file name

csrGenerationTime
int32

Timestamp when the Certificate Signing Request (CSR) was generated
